notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi! We fixed some bugs that was found by you and another one patch is coming soon. Check "One of the best!" and similar achievements (you have to complete any level to get missing achievements (even the level that was completed before)).
Thansk for reporting and help in bug fixes!

notes.title: Belated update from Foxi
notes.notes:
Hello friends! ːsteamhappyː

This time we fixed small bugs:
1) The game now remembers the size of the window mode.

2) Fixed the tool counter. The "Undo" is still infinite.

3) The best result - our minimum number of moves without the use of tools is now indicated at each level (in some levels you can beat this number and get better result than we did, but you have to try hard ːsteammockingː). Also, we added indication of the perfect level pass-through (The stars will be green and you can see the indication on the level selection screen).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/3fecd69c0a31bc65ac0de598182f6d312f8c167c.png

4) At level 34 there is a cycle of arrows, moving to them leads to infinite loop (it was not an obvious loss). Now on this section the character will stop after a certain number of moves.

I would like to add a few words about "Teleports without number". This is not a bug, it was intended. I am an artist, I will not change it ːsteammockingː

We want to apologize for being lost for a while and not fixing these minor bugs. Now we are working hard on the mobile version of this game and the development of new levels.

A small spoiler for new chips:
There will be two new elements. Laser (as we promised before), and Pusher. You will learn more about what it is and how it works in new levels. New levels are coming soon and they gonna have a new enviroment look sutable for them.

We are sorry because of such a pause in development. We are (hopefully) guys and gonna become better with your help.

notes.title: Global update from Foxy
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we changed a lot of things in this update while trying to remove mobile origin of the game.

Major changes
We removed purchases and chests along with a currency. How do we gonna get tools and characters? It’s easy! Now on each level you gonna get 5 pieces of each bonus items. The ‘Undo’ bonus is now infinite on each level. The characters will be opening after completion of certain levels (not each level).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/fb94d74d7e8d76b59aad992342d23d9832003121.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/1304cfd36441ffdcabd3ced901712c530705a835.png

Small changes and fixes
Camera should save it’s position on the level properly. 
Added scroll with mouse wheel on the levels selector.

Improved graphics
Removed achievements related to chest opening (they now make no sense)
Those who were facing issue with achievements, please try to complete any level, or repeat elevator achievement. It should now complete properly.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/edc99c520e4d1b28cedfe809446b8e118e779fd8.png

We are always trying to improve the game and would like to see your reviews and feedback. Thanks for playing.

notes.title: Foxy decided to make update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/8f8766205e46b6f7c184fe771c98e4eb35e1f7f6.png

Hello my friend! The game has a new useful feature! New window with information about the Max turns count to get the certain amount of stars on the level. Now you are able to see in advance how many movements are to be done and find out your best result at this level.
